title: Lynn Fisher: an archive of every past version of the site (v.I–v.XIX)
note: The Archive page stacks a framed greyscale screenshot of every yearly redesign since 2007, labelled 'v. XIX', 'v. XVIII'… with the year or a case-study link on the right. Everything on her site is greyscale, so her own work never fights the layout. Worth reusing for Petra: a 'playground' of the creative sites shown as still, labelled, equally sized frames, with the colour saved for when you open one.
